versions.changelog:
v1.0.0
- Added an IELTS grading skill for Writing and Speaking based on local official-style band descriptors.
- Enforced workflow: identify task type, collect prompt info (writing required), verify prompt online (writing mandatory), then score.
- Added robust handling for prompt/version conflicts (use prompt text and data points as source of truth).
- Improved evidence-based scoring: each criterion requires supporting text evidence and confidence calibration.
- Added concise Chinese output template with score breakdown, loss points, and actionable improvement suggestions.
